name: Cratonys

generalAbilities.name: Painsight
generalAbilities.description: A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the Doomed, Dying, and Wounded conditions, as well as the value of those conditions

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Unnerving Gaze
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it sees the face of a departed loved one in place of the evangelist's face. The creature must succeed at a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 2 (Frightened 3 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Animate Chains
offensiveAbilities.description: Chains in the evangelist's vicinity sprout barbs and writhe menacingly. The evangelist can make chain Strikes against any creature that is adjacent to an unattended chain within 20 feet, in addition to those within the reach of the evangelist's chain Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Focus Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
The evangelist stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save against Unnerving gaze. In addition, if the creature was already Frightened, on a failed save, the evangelist is Concealed from the creature for as long as the creature remains frightened.

After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the evangelist's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Impaling Chain
offensiveAbilities.description:
When the evangelist critically hits with a chain Strike, the target is impaled and anchored in place, becoming Grabbed by the chain. The creature is unable to recover from persistent bleed damage until it gets free (Escape dc=25).

Effect: Impaling Chain

offensiveAbilities.name: Rusty Chains
offensiveAbilities.description:
When Cratonys damages a creature with her chains, including persistent bleed damage from being impaled by a chain, the creature must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw or contract a severe form of tetanus called velstrac tetanus.

Velstracs sometimes intentionally infect their chains with dangerous diseases, such as this aggressive form of tetanus. Tetanus can produce stiffness, muscle spasms strong enough to break bones, and ultimately death.

Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1d4 days

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 week)

Stage 2 Clumsy 2 and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 3 Paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 4 death
